claim: The Current Doctrine of Qualified Immunity for Police Officers in 42 U.S.C. § 1983 Cases Details Qualified immunity shields police officers sued under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 from damages unless they violated "clearly established" law — a two-prong test under which courts may decide either prong first, and the right must be defined with great specificity.
